title: Glowing bicycle
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Glow effect background -->
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='60%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#1a4a2a' stop-opacity='0.6'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#0a1a0a' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <filter id='softGlow'>
      <feGaussianBlur stdDeviation='1.5' result='blur'/>
      <feMerge>
        <feMergeNode in='blur'/>
        <feMergeNode in='SourceGraphic'/>
      </feMerge>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <!-- Subtle glow behind bike -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='42' ry='28' fill='#1a4a2a' opacity='0.3'/>

  <!-- Back wheel -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='65' r='16' fill='none' stroke='#00e87b' stroke-width='2.5' filter='url(#softGlow)'/>
  <circle cx='25' cy='65' r='14' fill='none' stroke='#00e87b' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Back wheel spokes -->
  <line x1='25' y1='49' x2='25' y2='81' stroke='#00e87b' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='9' y1='65' x2='41' y2='65' stroke='#00e87b' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='13.7' y1='53.7' x2='36.3' y2='76.3' stroke='#00e87b' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='36.3' y1='53.7' x2='13.7' y2='76.3' stroke='#00e87b' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Back hub -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='65' r='2.5' fill='#7bffb3'/>

  <!-- Front wheel -->
  <circle cx='75' cy='65' r='16' fill='none' stroke='#00e87b' stroke-width='2.5' filter='url(#softGlow)'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='65' r='14' fill='none' stroke='#00e87b' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.5'/>
  <!-- Front wheel spokes -->
  <line x1='75' y1='49' x2='75' y2='81' stroke='#00e87b' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='59' y1='65' x2='91' y2='65' stroke='#00e87b' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='63.7' y1='53.7' x2='86.3' y2='76.3' stroke='#00e87b' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <line x1='86.3' y1='53.7' x2='63.7' y2='76.3' stroke='#00e87b' stroke-width='0.8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- Front hub -->
  <circle cx='75' cy='65' r='2.5' fill='#7bffb3'/>

  <!-- Frame - main triangle -->
  <line x1='25' y1='65' x2='50' y2='42' stroke='#ff6b9d' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' filter='url(#softGlow)'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='42' x2='75' y2='65' stroke='#ff6b9d' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round' filter='url(#softGlow)'/>
  <line x1='25' y1='65' x2='50' y2='65' stroke='#ff6b9d' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='42' x2='50' y2='65' stroke='#ff6b9d' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Chainstay -->
  <line x1='25' y1='65' x2='50' y2='65' stroke='#ff6b9d' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Seat tube extended -->
  <line x1='50' y1='42' x2='47' y2='35' stroke='#ff6b9d' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Seat -->
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='33' rx='6' ry='2.5' fill='#ffaa00' stroke='#ffdd66' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- Handlebar stem -->
  <line x1='50' y1='42' x2='58' y2='38' stroke='#00ccff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' filter='url(#softGlow)'/>

  <!-- Handlebar -->
  <line x1='54' y1='38' x2='62' y2='38' stroke='#00ccff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' filter='url(#softGlow)'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='38' r='2' fill='#66eeff'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='38' r='2' fill='#66eeff'/>

  <!-- Fork -->
  <line x1='58' y1='38' x2='75' y2='65' stroke='#ff6b9d' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- Pedal crank -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='65' r='4' fill='#ffaa00' stroke='#ffdd66' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='61' x2='54' y2='69' stroke='#ffaa00' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Pedals -->
  <rect x='43' y='58' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffdd66'/>
  <rect x='52' y='70' width='5' height='2' rx='1' fill='#ffdd66'/>

  <!-- Chain -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='20' ry='12' fill='none' stroke='#aaffcc' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.4' stroke-dasharray='2,2'/>

  <!-- Glow particles / sparkles -->
  <circle cx='15' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#00e87b' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='35' r='1.5' fill='#00e87b' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='90' cy='50' r='1' fill='#ff6b9d' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='10' cy='55' r='1' fill='#ff6b9d' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='20' r='1.2' fill='#00ccff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='65' cy='18' r='1.2' fill='#00ccff' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Sparkle star shapes -->
  <path d='M20,30 l1,-3 l1,3 l3,1 l-3,1 l-1,3 l-1,-3 l-3,-1 z' fill='#7bffb3' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M80,25 l0.8,-2.5 l0.8,2.5 l2.5,0.8 l-2.5,0.8 l-0.8,2.5 l-0.8,-2.5 l-2.5,-0.8 z' fill='#ffdd66' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
